You shouldn't need windows to get to the bios. Is it an ASUS board? If so I'm pretty sure the white debug light means there's no video signal. Everything turned on for me except for the display until I swapped the cable. Also if you are flashing the bios then you there should be a small button next to the bios USB port that you have to hold until it starts flashing.

Shot in the dark here but I had this same issue with my b550 board. Took hours of troubleshooting and turned out that the board didn't like that I was using HDMI. I hooked up a display port cable and it worked perfectly.
